intro: Laughing Sister's Hair consists of soft, magical locks harvested from dryads residing in the enchanted forests of Ashenvale. Highly sought after by skilled weavers, these strands possess innate mystical properties ideal for crafting fine robes.

p: Harvested from the dryads known as laughing sisters near Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale, this hair holds remarkable natural magic. While dryads are sacred woodland protectors linked to Cenarius and the night elves, craftsmen within the Horde value their hair purely as a potent crafting reagent. The troll tailor Kil'hala at the Crossroads spins these gathered locks into enchanted vestments for burgeoning practitioners of the arcane.
